requiredSingleValueHeaders.X-Correlation-ID: single canonical lowercase UUID equal to request body correlationId

successHeaders.ETag: single strong numeric ETag matching the returned version
successHeaders.X-Correlation-ID: same canonical lowercase UUID as the accepted request

pathRules: handoffId is a canonical lowercase UUID

bindings.path: canonical path with the exact lowercase handoffId and no query or trailing alias
bindings.tenantId: positive signed owner tenant from the verified proof only
bindings.tenantGrantRevision: exact Time-owner current revalidated tenant grant revision
bindings.policyRevision: exact Time-owner current revalidated policy revision
bindings.requestBodySha256: lowercase SHA-256 of exact received UTF-8 body bytes

time: exp minus iat is at most 30 seconds
replay: jti and requestNonce are distinct canonical lowercase UUIDs
jti and requestNonce share one durable single-use namespace for the proof validity window
a business-outcome retry uses a fresh valid proof

derivedAuthentication.rule: authn is re-derived from the verified certificate and registered kid profile and is never trusted from the claim alone
derivedAuthentication.MTLS_SPIFFE: TLS 1.3 client certificate SPIFFE SAN is exactly spiffe://dwp/service/dwp-payroll-server and maps to workload dwp-payroll-server
derivedAuthentication.CLIENT_CREDENTIAL_JWT: kid resolves to a registered dwp-payroll-server client-key profile

workloadProof.identityAgreement: certificate workload, X-DWP-Service-Identity, iss and sub are each exactly dwp-payroll-server

tenantAdmission: tenantId is a positive signed owner tenant and comes only from the verified proof
Time revalidates its current tenant grant authorizing dwp-payroll-server for the signed tenant
tenantGrantRevision and policyRevision each exactly equal Time current revalidated revisions
correlationBinding: request body correlationId equals the single X-Correlation-ID header

transitions.receiptRule: same receiverReceiptId and exact next receiverReceiptRevision

stateMachine.conflict: invalid transition, outcomeCommandDigest conflict, receipt identity conflict or revision gap returns 409 and requires quarantine plus audit

idempotency.sameOutcomeCommandDigest: return the original persisted 200 response without a second state transition

response.etag: strong numeric ETag matching the returned version

400.when: strict JSON, additionalProperties, required, nullability, format, path parameter, X-Correlation-ID or body/header correlation validation fails

401.when: missing, malformed, unverifiable or expired workload proof, reused jti or requestNonce, or missing or invalid mTLS

403.when: verified caller has wrong audience, binding, purpose, method, path, grant, tenantGrantRevision or policyRevision

404.when: tenant or target mismatch using one constant opaque representation

409.when: outcome transition, outcomeCommandDigest or receiver revision conflict

503.when: trust, grant, replay-store, provider or dependency authority is unavailable

errorProfile.invalidOrMissingRequestCorrelation: Time generates one canonical lowercase UUID and uses it identically in the response header and problem body
errorProfile.nonDisclosure: Every error uses a constant title for its status and omits handoff existence and all target-derived data.

ownership.runtimeAvailabilityNonclaim: This DRAFT contract does not establish close-only runtime availability.
successorRuntimePrerequisites: central CommandReceiptController and TimecardOwnerAccessFilter remain conditional on dwp.hris.time.timecard.enabled
current receipt verification uses Timecard authority evidence
a future TIM replacement must supply equivalent independently verified receipt and owner-access authority before removing the Timecard dependency
